description: Northern Provincial Council - Notify the Draft Standard By-Laws for Municipal Councils, Urban Councils & Pradeshiya Sabhas
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of draft standard by-laws for municipal councils under the Local Authorities (Standard By-Laws) Act. It contains detailed regulatory frameworks for various municipal activities including food vending, waste disposal, public health, and disaster management. While it mentions a government official (C.V. Wigneswaran) and his ministerial portfolios, the core content is legislative/regulatory in nature - establishing legal frameworks and compliance requirements rather than focusing on government personnel changes or structural reorganization. The content fits Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks.
